notes: Counts: 96 rows; 79 in_definition; 41 in_definition AND plant_confirmed with fetch_page --check verified quotes (28 firm, 13 boundary-flagged: hull material unstated or edge product such as liftboats, small dredges, yachts, or support yard). The 38 in_definition rows without plant_confirmed are leads only (trade-press-only, sites refused, or location/role not stated).

Source failures (logged once): PVA member directory is members-only; AWO affiliate list pages 2+ blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, so only affiliates A-Co were read (Big River Shipbuilders, Birdon America, Bollinger, C & C Marine and Repair, Channel Shipyard); ABS Record not attempted (JS app); Sea-Air-Space exhibitor directory not found as a public list; gdbiw.com, gdeb.com, baesystems.com, navy.mil, businessalabama.com returned 403/refused to the fetch tool; many small-yard sites refused connections (Main Iron Works, Master Boat Builders, Master Marine, McGinnis, Ironhead, Big River, Sterling, Southwest, Blount own site, MGBW own site).

Frame compliance: no OSHA, EPA or NAICS lists, no MARAD/SCA lists, no shipbuildinghistory.com. Search 5 returned HII's distributed-shipbuilding partner release (Trident Maritime Systems, Keel, Gulf Copper DDG units); those names were NOT used. Gulf Copper is included only because it is an independent WorkBoat exhibitor in the Shipyard category. Trident and Keel are omitted. Eastern Shipbuilding's own homepage mentions its Navy structural-unit contracts; it is included as a WorkBoat exhibitor.

Trade-press-only rows (WorkBoat, Marine Log, Waterways Journal, MarineLink, USNI, Baird) are kept with plant_confirmed=false and an empty quote, flagged in note; they are discovery leads, not confirmed plants.

Category self-tagging on the WorkBoat directory is noisy (staffing firms, paint suppliers, Path Robotics itself appear under Shipyard); only builders/fabricators were kept. Aluminum-only exhibitors (All American Marine, MetalCraft, North River, SAFE Boats, Silver Ships, Rozema, Willard, Moose, Lake Assault, TOUGH BOATS, Zin) were not profiled individually; LM Workboats and Fincantieri ACE are kept as out-of-definition examples with page evidence.

Multi-yard parents are split one row per yard from the company's own location pages (Bollinger, Conrad, Eastern, Fincantieri, Chouest). Repair-only yards of those parents are kept as in_definition=false.

Blind spots: (1) trade-show and association membership skews to Gulf Coast commercial yards and firms with marketing budgets; small inland, Great Lakes, Alaska and steel-yacht builders that do not exhibit are under-covered; (2) structural-unit and module suppliers to Navy primes are hard to see without the banned HII/EB partner lists, so naval component fabricators (foundations, tanks, units) are probably the biggest gap; (3) owner fleet pages rarely name builders, so many builders surfaced only via trade press and stay unconfirmed; (4) membership directories behind logins or bot challenges (PVA, AWO pages 2+, ABS Record) were not read; (5) material (steel vs aluminum) is often unstated, leaving several boundary rows.
Personal data: an email address in one exhibitor address field (Blount Boats) was dropped.

Not attempted or unread: ABS Record was never attempted; PVA member directory (members-only), Sea-Air-Space exhibitor directory (no public list found) and AWO affiliate pages 2+ (Cloudflare) went unread. Breaux Brothers, John Bludworth Shipyard and Diversified Marine Inc. were dropped (frame-doubtful or unmatched source). Field 'boundary' added per row.
